You will hear Alex and Mum arranging a journey.
Alex: Are we flying to Italy on Saturday?
Mum: No, our tickets are for Spain. We are flying on Sunday.
Alex: Is the flight at six?
Mum: It leaves at eleven. We need to reach the airport early.
Alex: Shall we take a taxi?
Mum: Your uncle is driving us there in his car.
Alex: Is my cousin coming too?
Mum: No, just you, your sister and me. She is staying with Dad.
Alex: Are we having lunch on the plane?
Mum: No, we are eating before we get on. I have booked a table at the airport cafe.
